facts.fact: The Cyber Security Authority's own press release of 12 August 2026 states it sanctioned the ORC and Purpleline under Sections 92 of the Cybersecurity Act, 2020 (Act 1038).
The press release refers to institutions designated as Critical Information Infrastructure, and says the CSA directed the ORC on 15 June 2026 to engage Tier 1 licensed providers for its CII.

note: Sanctions are not incidents handled or alerts issued, so no response fact.
